text.text: payment-service is failing from multiple concurrent production issues: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion and `DB_CONN_TIMEOUT` errors, repeated `OOMKilled`/`CrashLoopBackOff` restarts with `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space`, and gateway `502/504` upstream timeouts to `/api/v1/payments`. The blast radius includes `payment-service`, `postgres-primary`, `api-gateway`, `kubelet`/`kubernetes`, `auth-service`, and `redis-cache`, with a recent `payment-service` deploy `v2.8.4` also showing reduced availability at `1/6` replicas. Overall severity is P1, and users are seeing failed payment requests, intermittent 401 auth failures, and prolonged request timeouts. The single most critical next step is to roll back `payment-service` from `v2.8.4` to `v2.8.3` immediately.
